name: Lladurs (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow triangle rising from the lower edge, surmounted by a black castle between two yellow thistles of three flowers.
history: The official flag of Lladurs is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the yellow mount of the arms converted into a triangle at whose upper vertex stands the black castle closed in white of the arms, accompanied by two yellow thistles of three flowers; approved on 16 April 2007 and published in the DOGC on 25 May 2007.

features.role: mount converted into a triangle with its apex at the centre
castle at the apex of the triangle, open in white
door and windows of the castle
two thistles of three flowers flanking the castle
